ITEM 1 | Toasted bread half, golden-brown and lightly charred edges, rough porous crumb surface, irregular rounded shape about 9 cm by 7 cm, sitting on the lower-left of a white plate; top covered by a thick, opaque off-white spread with soft, slightly glossy creamy texture and a small dollop in the lower center | 95

ITEM 2 | Toasted bread half, golden-brown with darker toasted spots and a rough, uneven crumb surface, roughly 10 cm by 8 cm, on the right of the plate; a single mound of off-white spread about 4 cm by 3 cm and about 1.5 cm high sits on its center, soft and smooth with slight sheen | 85

ITEM 3 | Cucumber slices, pale to mid green skin with lighter inner flesh, three overlapping thin rounds about 4 cm in diameter and 0.5 cm thick, stacked in a fan at the top-left of the plate, firm, moist-looking, uncooked | 20

ITEM 4 | Off-white soft spread, thick and creamy with a matte-to-slightly-glossy surface, spread across the left bread half and a portion of its top, clumpy in places, about 1 cm thick at the mound | 35
